title: Calculate the Product of Digits
question: Read an integer and calculate the product of its digits using a loop.
code:
number = abs(int(input("Integer: ")))
product = 1
while number > 0:
    product *= number % 10
    number //= 10
print("Product of digits:", product)
expected_output:
For input 234:
Integer: 234
Product of digits: 24
explanation: Modulo extracts the last digit, and integer division removes it; zero is handled as a product of 1 in this simple implementation.
